answer.summary: Whisker Hollow is one small organic hamlet of crooked lanes round a green. The librarian's large library-home stands at the centre beside the feeding hall. Three cat dorms, a garden courtyard, a sick bay and a fish shed fill out the lanes, and the gatehouse sits at the edge. The fish shed wants water nearby. The land isn't surveyed, so I wrote no pond or river. The style is set after this plan.
